entities.name: Larry Fink
entities.control_summary: CEO of BlackRock. Economic power through the institution's 13F book, not voting control of any newsroom.
entities.notes: Click through from BlackRock. Not attached to CNN by default.

entities.name: Salim Ramji
entities.control_summary: CEO of Vanguard. Same structure as Fink: officer of an index manager, not a dual-class media controller.

entities.name: Ron O'Hanley
entities.control_summary: Chairman and CEO of State Street. Officer of an institutional holder.

entities.name: Robert Iger
entities.control_summary: CEO of Disney. Hired executive. No dual-class lock on ABC News.

entities.name: Lachlan Murdoch
entities.control_summary: Chair of Fox and the operating principal of the Murdoch family voting block.

entities.name: Rupert Murdoch
entities.control_summary: Patriarch of the Murdoch family trusts that vote Fox and News Corp Class B.

entities.name: Brian Roberts
entities.control_summary: Holds Comcast Class B. Charter locks that class at one-third of voting power.

entities.name: A.G. Sulzberger
entities.control_summary: Publisher and chairman of The New York Times Company. Family Class B elects a majority of the board.

entities.name: David Ellison
entities.control_summary: Chair and CEO of Paramount Skydance. Family holds 77.5% of voting Class A. Not yet owner of CNN.

entities.name: Larry Ellison
entities.control_summary: Voting-control principal of Paramount Skydance alongside David Ellison.
